idea: Count to 10 with Baby Jimmy at the supermarket, counting oranges 1-5 then 6-10 (two rows of five), with a 'How many?' pause and a loop ending.
title: Wow! Ten Little Oranges! 🍊 Count to 10 with Baby Jimmy | Learn Numbers | Crayon Babies
description:
Oh! Roll, roll, roll! One little orange rolls up to Baby Jimmy at the supermarket - and soon there are ten! Count all the way from 1 to 10 with Jimmy and his bright orange oranges.

🎬 What happens in this video:
🍊 One little orange rolls up and surprises Baby Jimmy
☝️ Jimmy counts a row of oranges: one, two, three, four, five!
👏 Five and five make ten - he claps for ten little oranges
🤔 "How many oranges? Hmm?" - can you count them too?
👋 "Ten! Bye bye, friends!"

📚 Kids learn: counting 1-10 in order • numbers • the word "ten" • orange

🎶 Voices only: children singing, humming and clapping with a soft hand drum - no other musical instruments.

A fun cartoon for toddlers and preschoolers about counting to 10 with a sweet little baby and ten bright oranges.
